@export
def create_locker(token_contract: str, locker_name: str, lp_amount: float, lock_end_day: int, lock_end_month: int, lock_end_year: int):
    assert lp_amount > 0, 'Must provide lp points amount!'
    assert token_contract != None, 'Must provide token contract!'
    assert lock_end_day != None, 'Must provide end day of lock!'
    assert lock_end_month != None, 'Must provide end month of lock!'
    assert lock_end_year != None, 'Must provide end year of lock!'
    assert datetime.datetime(year=lock_end_year, month=lock_end_month, day=lock_end_day) >= now, 'Lock end cannot be in the past!'
    if(lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name]) == 0:
        rocketswap.transfer_liquidity_from(contract=token_contract, to=ctx.this, main_account=ctx.caller, amount=lp_amount)
        rocketswap.transfer_liquidity(contract=token_contract, to=metadata['FEE_WALLET'], amount=(lp_amount/100*metadata['FEE_PERCENTAGE']))
        lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name] = [lp_amount - (lp_amount/100*metadata['FEE_PERCENTAGE']), datetime.datetime(year=lock_end_year, month=lock_end_month, day=lock_end_day, hour=0, minute=0, microsecond=0)]
    else:
        return "There is already a locker running with this name."
@export
def end_locker(token_contract: str, locker_name: str):
    assert token_contract != None, 'Must provide token contract!'
    assert lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name][1] <= now, 'The end of liquidity lock is not reached yet!'
    rocketswap.transfer_liquidity(contract=token_contract, to=ctx.caller, amount=lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name][0])
    lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name].clear()

def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == metadata['OWNER'
        ], 'Only owner can set metadata!'
